title: A latest-anchor induction with spectrally compact masks for worst-case trace reconstruction

issues.location: Radial compactification, estimate (6) and the complex-shift bound on |K(x-iy)|

coverage: Read the full LaTeX (summary + part-1). Checked: the small-n and extreme-p reductions and the padding; the parameter recursion (v_{h+1}=v_h^2/2, a_b n<.0001, P_0=O(2^b)); the base step (Fine–Wilf argument, P_0-separation of occurrences, the shape of H, the e^{-v} lower bound, Poisson harmonic-measure bound O(b^2)=o(B_0)); the Gaussian-polynomial mask (Taylor remainder, log Y bound); the Poisson/Cauchy density inequality; numerical tables M, J*, T_lim (recomputed in python, all strict inequalities hold); the quadratic minimization giving G+Q>1.004 vs ≤1.003; q_s case analysis; reference-pair/fractional-cover argument including j=0; angle bookkeeping for quadruple (sum 1) and triple frequencies and the magnitude lower bounds; the contradiction margin .1E; the Fourier bound (3) (polynomial bound ζ^{-ℓ}e^{ζ|z|^2/2}, sum-of-squares identity, X-integration) and the constant ≈1.20008B<1.203B; Q≥rḡ²/(r−1); the tail exponent 7.47B>7.2031B; the retained-ω bound min 7.8e^{-x}+6x−.04>7.4; mask-count/size induction bounds and loose-edge coverage after merging; (7) giving ℓ*8^b(b+1)^6; the κ≥c_0 q argument via Cauchy–Schwarz with ≤3·4^{j-h-1}≤M_h coverings; disk-inclusion identity p²−|y−q|²=p(1−|y|²)−q|1−y|²; boundedness of G and T; the three-lines step; the trace-expectation identity E T = p^k z_0^{d−k+1}∏z_e^{-1}G; the final exponent conversion to X; and the general-alphabet reduction. Not checked line by line: the constants in the complex-shift proof of (6), and the O(H_*)-interval discretization claim, which I only checked qualitatively.
main_claim: Worst-case trace reconstruction with retention probability p uses exp(O(p^{-1}(log n)^3(1+log log 2n)^6)) traces. More finely, the log of the sample size is O(p^{-1} log n · X^2(1+log X)^6) with X=1+log n/(1+log(1/q)), so polynomially many traces suffice when q≤n^{-ε}. The bound also holds for general alphabets. It is proved by a latest-anchor generating-function induction with Fourier phase tests and spectrally compact masks, followed by three-lines interpolation at the last pivot.
sibling_notes: The family 122 board was empty when I started. Results I verified that could be reused: (a) the numeric tables (M, J*, T_lim) pass with margin; (b) the Gaussian-Fourier constant 1.203B is valid for r≤4 with ε=ζ=1e-5; (c) the κ-bound design relies on (#level-h coverings)≤M_h=4^{b-h}, which makes Σ a_h²/R_h=O(1/q).
